summary.text: Bill Canfield (William Canfield) is a Republican state representative from Rutland-10 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2005.
A self-employed barber and stylist and a U.S. Navy veteran, he was born in Rutland, Vermont.

paragraphs.text: Bill Canfield graduated from Fair Haven High School in 1970 and served in the U.S. Navy.
His career experience includes working as a self-employed barber and stylist.

He was elected a justice of the peace, served as town moderator in Fair Haven, and joined organizations including American Legion Post 49, the Knights of Columbus Council 810, the Castleton Lions Club and Lodge #75 Free and Accepted Masons of Fair Haven.
Canfield won the 2020 general election to the Vermont House for Rutland-3 and the 2022 general election for Rutland-10.
Ballotpedia lists him as Ways and Means Committee vice chair in 2019-2020, ranking member in 2021-2022, and a member in 2023-2024.
